app.title: Proposal Arena
app.subtitle: Upload your proposal, configure your AI examiner, and start your defense.

steps.step1Desc: Ensure your proposal is in PDF format (Max 10MB).
steps.step2Desc: Click or drag the file into the area on the right.
steps.step3Desc: Configure your AI examiner and begin the defense session.

upload.title: Upload Proposal
upload.description: Drag and drop your PDF or TXT file here, or click to select.

settings.title: Settings
settings.proxyHint: Optional. Override the default API endpoint.

interview.stagingSubtitle: Are you ready to start your defense?
interview.dictationUnsupported: Speech recognition is not supported in this browser. Try Chrome.
interview.handsFreePrivacyDesc: Hands-Free mode uses your browser's Web Speech API for real-time speech recognition. In some browsers (such as Google Chrome), voice audio may be processed on vendor servers (e.g. Google) for speech-to-text conversion. Your thesis document and evaluation remain private and local. You can pause or stop hands-free mode at any time.

integrity.title: Session Integrity
integrity.warning: Warning: We noticed you switched tabs or minimized the window. For the integrity of the examination, please remain focused.
integrity.reportWarning: Session Integrity: You switched tabs or lost window focus {count} times during the defense.

report.title: Defense Debrief & Guidance
report.subtitle: Constructive evaluation notes and argument readiness mapping towards your actual proposal defense.
report.emptyReport: Debrief notes for this session were not found.
report.strengthsDesc: Points of argument and understanding that are already sharp and should be maintained before the committee.
report.weaknessesDesc: Methodological or conceptual gaps that examiners are likely to scrutinize.
report.recommendationsDesc: Concrete preparation and revision priorities you can undertake before the actual defense day.
report.practiceDesc: Prompt questions to test the sharpness of your response and research defense logic.

tutorial.title: Gemini API Key Guide
tutorial.subtitle: Get a free API Key from Google AI Studio to run simulations.
tutorial.step1: Visit Google AI Studio at aistudio.google.com.
tutorial.step2: Sign in using your Google account.
tutorial.step3: Select 'Get API key' from the left navigation sidebar.
tutorial.step4: Click 'Create API key' and copy your generated key token.
tutorial.step5: Open Settings in this application and paste your API key.
tutorial.privacyNote: Your API key is stored only in your local browser (localStorage) and sent directly to Google.
